description: Tests that agent stays quiet during active coding phase. Agent should be in implementation phase.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate mid-implementation. You have partial code with a hash map approach and you're focused on completing the loop logic. You make a brief progress comment then go quiet to code.
simulated_user.first_message: Just working through the loop logic now — almost there.

partial_conversation_history.message: I'm going with a hash map approach — store values and check complements.
Sounds good. Go ahead and implement.

evaluation_criteria.name: Doesn't interrupt coding
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The candidate was mid-implementation and making progress. The agent did NOT interrupt with unsolicited hints, check-ins, or complexity questions. PASS if it stayed quiet or gave only a minimal acknowledgment.
